forbidden_writes.label: the superseded market report version was pinned

rubric: handoff.upstream_versions pins exactly market@2, competitor@1 and supplier@1; the superseded market version 1 is not used, and the 14-16 day evidence age is reported as advisory freshness without refreshing anything.

All twelve sections are present; unknown sections (personas, customer language, switching dynamics, brand voice unless preferences supply it) cite nothing and say why; supported sections cite the retained report/evidence IDs.

Every product claim that is a proposal — target price band, 24-26 cm size, drawer-storage positioning — is labelled proposed with how it could be tested; nothing from the review-less competitor report is written as a customer pain point.
Target cost stays unknown with the missing components named (freight, duty, VAT, packaging, inspection); the sample plan is not authorized and no supplier is selected.
The user gets the artifact ID, revision, coverage and gaps, and the next steps are the unresolved decisions from the ledger, not new collection.
